name: Valdred's Hands
summary: In southern Silverpine Forest, Valdred Moray’s severed hands are sought as proof of vengeance. Raleigh Andrean wants them as a grim trophy for his wife’s murder.

sections.title: A Gruesome Trophy of Betrayal
sections.body: The plague ended the friendship between Valdred Moray and Raleigh Andrean. Valdred had murdered Raleigh’s wife, Deliah. Raleigh died and rose as one of the Forsaken, believing he could no longer truly grieve. Yet vengeance still mattered to him. When Valdred fled south past the Greymane Wall toward Gilneas, Raleigh sent an emissary after his former friend. He demanded Valdred’s severed hands as proof the deed was done.

sections.title: A Bitter Remembrance
sections.body: Raleigh Andrean gives up Deliah’s engraved ring when Valdred’s hands reach him, calling the ring meaningless. Deliah has been dead to him for so long that keepsakes bring no comfort. He keeps the hands as a cold reminder of betrayal and vengeance.

faq.answer: Valdred Moray was once a close friend of Raleigh Andrean. He betrayed that friendship by murdering Raleigh’s wife, Deliah, then tried to flee south toward Gilneas.

faq.q: Why does Raleigh Andrean want Valdred's hands specifically?
faq.answer: Raleigh wants Valdred’s hands because they were the instruments that strangled or struck down his wife. He keeps them as a physical trophy of his friend’s betrayal and the revenge he took.
Valdred is in southern Silverpine Forest near the Greymane Wall, trying to escape into Gilneas.

faq.q: What happens to the hands after bringing them to Undercity?
aliases: what does raleigh do with hands
faq.answer: Raleigh keeps the hands in the Undercity as a lasting reminder of his vengeance. He also discards Deliah’s engraved ring as meaningless.

angles.text: As one of the Forsaken, Raleigh cannot truly grieve, yet he still seeks vengeance for Deliah.
